journey.name: Study loop — reveal and grade due cards
journey.description: Spaced-repetition session over the deck created in journey 02. New cards count as due. Requires journeys 01 and 02 to have run (signed in, "Animals PT" deck exists).

actions.action: Launch the Loopky app and verify the Home screen is shown
Tap the element with resource-id "tab_decks", then tap the "Animals PT" deck tile
Verify the deck detail screen shows a due-cards count greater than zero and a study button (resource-id: deck_study)
Tap the element with resource-id "deck_study" to start a session
Verify a study card is shown with a position indicator like "1 of 3" and the card front text visible
Tap the element with resource-id "study_card" to reveal the answer

Verify the flip buzzed once. On an emulator there is no actuator to feel, so read it back with `adb shell dumpsys vibrator_manager | grep loopky` — a ContextClick (constant=6) attributed to com.github.jvsena42.loopky. Tap the already-flipped card again and verify NO second entry appears: a tap that changed nothing must not buzz
Verify the card back is revealed and four grade buttons are shown (resource-ids: study_again, study_hard, study_good, study_easy)
Verify the session advanced to the next card ("2 of 3")
Reveal each remaining card (study_card) and grade it with study_good
Verify a session-complete state is shown (summary or return affordance)

Verify the session ended on a single Confirm (constant=16) and that the LAST grade did not also tick — the final tap's acknowledgement is the completion's own buzz, because two a few milliseconds apart read as one smeared one
Tap the element with resource-id "study_close" and verify the app returns to the previous screen
